hook: Your drive here is Germany, with Switzerland on every side.
title: A German Town Surrounded By Switzerland
description:
Büsingen am Hochrhein is a German town completely surrounded by Swiss territory. It even has its own car plate prefix, BÜS. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
